n: 4.2 Cu. Ft. Smart Wi-fi Enabled Compact Front Load Dryer With Dual Inverter Heatpump™ Technology
desc: This compact dryer offers big style and big capacity, with a go-anywhere ventless design that can be installed side by side or stacked on top of a compact LG washer. But saving space is just the beginning—LG’s innovative HeatPump technology saves energy with the dryer usage on every load.
